title: Jeanne Eagels
description: A 1920s dancer/actress (Kim Novak) leaves her jealous lover (Jeff Chandler) for Broadway, Hollywood and alcoholic decline.

title: The Jolson Story
description: At the turn of the 20th century, young Asa Yoelson decides to go against the wishes of his cantor father and pursue a career in show business.

title: Human Desire
description: An Oklahoma train engineer's (Glenn Ford) lover (Gloria Grahame) wants him to kill her husband (Broderick Crawford).

title: Pal Joey
description: A singer (Frank Sinatra) flirts with a chorus girl (Kim Novak) from Albuquerque after a San Francisco socialite (Rita Hayworth) buys him a nightclub.

title: Shockproof
description: An ex-convict (Patricia Knight) flees with her Los Angeles parole officer (Cornel Wilde) after shooting her former lover (John Baragrey).

title: Pushover
description: A gangster's girlfriend (Kim Novak) seduces a police detective (Fred MacMurray) who has her under surveillance.

title: It Happened One Night
description: A newsman (Clark Gable) rides a bus and shares a cabin with a tycoon's (Walter Connolly) runaway daughter (Claudette Colbert).

title: All Ashore
description: Three sailors celebrate their shore leave in grand style by taking off on a spree to Catalina Island.

title: From Here to Eternity
description: While a Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor looms, an Army sergeant (Burt Lancaster), a former boxer (Montgomery Clift) and an officer's wife (Deborah Kerr) become entangled with others at an Army base on Oahu.

title: Mr. Smith Goes to Washington
description: A country bumpkin faces ridicule and corruption when he takes his idealistic views to the nation's capital.

title: The Caine Mutiny
description: A World War II Naval officer is court-martialed for relieving paranoid Capt. Queeg of command during a typhoon.

title: Mickey One
description: A nightclub comic (Warren Beatty) in debt to mobsters hides in Chicago at the mercy of his ego.

title: Berserk
description: Scotland Yard looks into spiking, buzz sawing and knifing at ringmaster Monica's traveling circus.

title: Middle of the Night
description: A widowed manufacturer (Fredric March) falls in love with a divorced employee (Kim Novak) 30 years his junior.

title: First Men in the Moon
description: An old man (Edward Judd) recalls how he, his fiancée (Martha Hyer) and a professor (Lionel Jeffries) planted a Union Jack on the moon in 1899.

title: Paula
description: A boy left mute by a hit-and-run accident discovers his speech teacher (Loretta Young) was the driver.

title: What a Woman!
description: An author (Willard Parker) and a literary agent (Rosalind Russell) become involved after selling film rights to his racy book.

title: The Happy Time
description: A violinist (Charles Boyer) and his brother (Louis Jourdan) guide one's son through his crush on the family maid in the 1920s Ottawa.

title: The Wackiest Ship in the Army
description: A captain (Jack Lemmon) and his ensign (Ricky Nelson) take a sorry ship and crew on a World War II spy mission.

title: You Were Never Lovelier
description: A tycoon (Adolphe Menjou) sends anonymous gifts to his daughter (Rita Hayworth) to make her fall for a mystery man he will choose later, but a dancer (Fred Astaire) he doesn't like takes the credit.

title: A Raisin in the Sun
description: Proud members (Sidney Poitier, Claudia McNeil, Ruby Dee) of a Chicago family argue over a $10,000 insurance windfall.

title: Hot Blood
description: A Gypsy king (Luther Adler) tricks his brother (Cornel Wilde) in Los Angeles into marrying a Roma bride (Jane Russell) that he bought.

title: The Heroes of Telemark
description: A freedom fighter (Richard Harris) and a scientist (Kirk Douglas) sink a shipment of heavy water en route to Berlin from a Nazi factory in Norway.

title: Forbidden
description: The mistress (Barbara Stanwyck) of a lawyer (Adolphe Menjou) running for governor marries an editor (Ralph Bellamy), who finds she has a baby.

title: Tell It to the Judge
description: A lawyer (Robert Cummings) chases his lawyer ex-wife (Rosalind Russell) from Florida to the Adirondacks, where she poses as a playboy's (Gig Young) wife.

title: Gidget Grows Up
description: Gidget goes to New York, becomes a U.N. guide and meets an older man.

title: The Guilt of Janet Ames
description: A World War II widow (Rosalind Russell) overcomes a mental block thanks to one (Melvyn Douglas) of the five soldiers her husband died for.

title: Pal Joey
description: A singer (Frank Sinatra) flirts with a chorus girl (Kim Novak) from Albuquerque after a San Francisco socialite (Rita Hayworth) buys him a nightclub.

title: Craig's Wife
description: A woman's (Rosalind Russell) obsession with neatness and material goods drives out her husband (John Boles), family and servants.

title: The Chance of a Lifetime
description: Sleuth Boston Blackie (Chester Morris) helps a wartime convict (Erik Rolf) framed for murder while out on parole.

title: How to Save a Marriage and Ruin Your Life
description: A bachelor (Dean Martin) tries to save his buddy's (Eli Wallach) marriage by stealing his mistress, who is not who he thinks.

title: Mr. Smith Goes to Washington
description: A country bumpkin faces ridicule and corruption when he takes his idealistic views to the nation's capital.

title: The Notorious Landlady
description: A U.S. diplomat (Jack Lemmon) tries to help his London landlady (Kim Novak) in a mix-up over jewels and her husband's murder.

title: Gidget
description: A California girl called Gidget (Sandra Dee) spends summer with surf bums called Moondoggie (James Darren) and Kahuna (Cliff Robertson).

title: Twentieth Century
description: An actress (Carole Lombard) deserts the Broadway director (John Barrymore) who bolstered her career, then meets him on the Chicago-New York express.

title: Don't Knock the Twist
description: Rock 'n' rollers (Chubby Checker, Gene Chandler, Vic Dana) put on a TV dance special.

title: Good Neighbor Sam
description: A San Francisco adman (Jack Lemmon) poses as his wife's friend's (Romy Schneider) husband so that she can inherit $15 million.

title: The Awful Truth
description: Spouses (Irene Dunne, Cary Grant) try to spoil each other's chances for romance before their divorce becomes final in 90 days.

title: The Magic Carpet
description: An ousted prince harnesses the power of a mystical floor covering to drive a villainous caliph from the throne.

title: Born Yesterday
description: A scrap-metal tycoon (Broderick Crawford) pays a Washington newsman (William Holden) to make his girlfriend (Judy Holliday) couth.

title: Bell, Book and Candle
description: A witch's (Kim Novak) warlock brother (Jack Lemmon) helps a San Francisco publisher (James Stewart) break a love spell.

title: Boots Malone
description: Has-been agent Boots Malone (William Holden) is dodging his creditors and living on the edge of the horse racing world when wealthy teenager Tommy Gibson (Johnny Stewart) asks Malone to take him under his wing as a jockey-in-training.
